purpose: Document verified public evidence without projecting subscriber or incomplete third-party pricing to all DEESB EVSEs.

officialFindings.publicAccess: ESB states that charging can be started by charging card, QR code or app; a Sulzemoos pilot also accepts contactless debit/credit card payment.

subscriberTariffNotAdHoc.warning: These are authenticated ESB-card tariffs and must not be used as the direct/ad-hoc tariff.

independentStationLevelSignal.warning: The public aggregator currently reports 0.49 EUR/kWh for its priced DEESB charge points, but its priced population is far smaller than the V9 BNetzA-derived DEESB population. It is therefore corroborating evidence only, not sufficient for a network-wide exact overlay.

neededToComplete: Resolve the direct QR/card-payment tariff contract for each ESB station/EVSE (for example via Ladenetz/Smartlab station payload, Mobilithek/AFIR tariff data, or the public checkout used by the QR flow), including any station-specific blocking/parking conditions. Only then apply exact ad-hoc pricing across DEESB.
